description.zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的**设备**页查看**DeviceName**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
description.en:
The name of the IPC device.
You can view the DeviceName on the **Devices** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

description.zh: 图片URL的失效时间，单位为分钟。
description.en: The expiration time of the picture URL. Unit: minutes.

description.zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
description.en:
The ID of the IPC device. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and is the unique identifier of the device. You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) on IoT Platform to query the ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the unique identifier of the device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

description.zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>

<props="intl">无需传入此参数。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
> If the public instance does not have an ID value, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter.</props>

description.zh:
图片ID列表。图片ID由调用[TriggerCapturePicture](~~107914~~)时生成。

> 单次调用最多支持输入50个图片ID。
description.en:
The list of picture IDs. The picture IDs are generated when you call [TriggerCapturePicture](~~107914~~).

> A maximum of 50 picture IDs can be specified in a single call.

The type of the picture.

- **0**: thumbnail.
- **1**: original picture.
- **2** (default): all.

description.zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台**产品**页查看或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page in the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to view information about all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

description.zh: 指定目标缩放图的宽度，单位为px，取值范围为1~4096。
description.en: The width of the target thumbnail. Unit: pixels. Valid values: 1 to 4096.
